Triage: lands in `domain:ui` · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Bug · when a parent field group places a line table in the form, the row editor renders a form inside a form (invalid markup, a dev-console warning; behaviour correct), and in a tabbed form a line-level refusal can sit in an unopened tab where the user does not see it; follow-up of PR #36009, topic #35590 → p2 as filed (the hidden refusal is a UX problem) · size S.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-21T12:15Z · area b1-DB (p2 follow-up from #36009, epic #35590).
Area: b1-DB
Session: `session_01L6bhgW85kwjGaz7HqsmEuv` (the b1-DB area thread)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/issue-36019-placed-lines-form
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: the row editor's placement in a placed line slot and the tab marker in `TabbedForm` (the files the S2 patch `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35889/n2-expanded-editor-nesting.patch` names, re-measured on main), their tests, and a patch changeset.
Container & model: `S`, area sub-agent, `model: opus`, `effort: medium`
Clause-②: no (no export, prop or i18n key changes expected; the area re-reads it on the final diff)
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (seat, from the card): #36009 has merged, so the block is gone. Item 1 is a measured patch to re-apply on main; item 2 is new. The area reads both on main first and reports if either no longer holds.
Basis: card #36019; N2/N3 of the declaration record on #36009.
Scope, the seat's reading: the row editor in a placed slot draws no wrapper form, pinned with no nesting warning; a line refusal on Save marks the tab that holds the placed lines, with the same treatment a header-field error gets, pinned.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. #36039 (#36023 S5, the form's line-item grid cells) is open and held; `overlap-check.mjs` runs against it and #36054 before each push, and the second to land merges main. L1 at L1-a. The PR carries `Fixes #36019`.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim amendment · 2026-11-21T13:06Z · #36019, claim 7062447993, PR #36088

File surface, amended: the tab marker lives in the components form renderer (`erroredFieldTabs` in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`), not in `TabbedForm`, so the surface adds `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` and `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/formSlots.ts`, with their tests. The batch refusal is recorded in `FormSlotStore`, `TabbedForm` subscribes, and the renderer marks the slot's tab with the same style as a header-field error. This route keeps `Clause-②: no`, since marking through `TabbedForm` alone would need a new exported prop on `FormFieldTab`.
Scope, the seat's reading: a refused line marks its tab, which is the card's acceptance line. Switching to that tab and focusing it, as a header field does, is not in this PR; it is a small follow-up if wanted. The area's code-read note (a batch refusal may also set the error on a header input that shares a line field's name, not reproduced) is named in the PR body's acceptance notes and is not owed here.
Everything else in the claim stands.
